data.body: ADVANCED convergence_score=1 (partial). Both lenses fully agree: (1) claude-safe removes only its OWN worktree, TTY-gated (claude-safe:374 + [ -t 0 ]); its header 'lines 12-13: 10+ worktrees auto-cleanup' is DOC-ONLY fiction (grep confirms zero executable worktree-cleanup invocations). (2) end-session Step 12 is VERIFY-ONLY — prints 'claude-safe can auto-remove', never calls removal. (3) Class A unregistered dirs invisible: worktree-cleanup.sh:604 enumerates only 'git worktree list --porcelain'; no find/parent-dir scan; 'git worktree prune' cleans metadata only. Contradiction RESOLVED empirically: worktree-create.sh:156 only PRINTS a Note (no auto-invoke); historical lens's count>=10 invoke at worktree-create.sh:145 does NOT exist. Class B deeper cause (code-tracer, dynamic gate matrix over 22 worktrees + ~/.claude-safe-cleanup.log): worktree-cleanup.sh is never auto-invoked AND its is_clean (246-250 bare git status --porcelain) + age<12h + unpushed gates pin every merged human worktree on untracked session debris (.claude/scratch/, regenerable docs).
